data.gender_notes: Shokeen is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who cures ailments and removes suffering, derived from the name of Lord Shiva. The name Shokeen carries the meaning “Shiva's Cure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Shokeen usually hope their child will grow to embody shiva's cure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies spiritual strength and the power to overcome obstacles and suffering.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shokeen total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
